en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide sandy beach with scattered bathers and beach furniture along a shoreline. On the left are large wooden pavilion-style seaside buildings nestled against trees, and in the distance a long pier with structures extends into the sea. The foreground architecture and the orderly beach scene suggest an early 20th‑century European spa resort. Printed German text appears at the bottom.
